title: NOVA B frozen evidence-audit benchmark
scope: Discovery-stage evidence interpretation and next legal diagnostic only; not a scientific conclusion or authorization to run experiments.
scoring: Each answer, action, and citation-set component has equal weight. Numeric answers use per-answer absolute tolerance; null differs from zero; booleans are never numeric. Cite every supplied source reference exactly once; the exact citation set is scored.
